meta.title: 纸上剧场 · 丰西泽之夜（90 秒版）

scenes.narration: 丰西泽之夜：一个亭长，为什么敢放走刑徒？
code: const T = api.t; const C = TT.chronicle;
const CUES = api.cues.length ? api.cues : [{ text: '丰西泽之夜：一个亭长，为什么敢放走刑徒？', start: 0.7, end: 5.0 }];
const at = (i, dt = 0) => (CUES[i]?.start ?? 0) + dt;
TT.board.stage(ctx, { W, H }, { seed: 3, variant: 0, screen: 'white' });
const q = C.seg(T, at(0, -0.2), at(0, 0.7), C.E.out);
ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha = 0.16 + 0.22 * q; C.gate(ctx, { t: T, at: 0.1, x: 260, y: 520, w: 340, h: 360 }); ctx.restore();
TT.text(ctx, '丰西泽之夜', W * 0.5, H * 0.18, 44, { fontKey: 'sans-900', color: '#7A1E14', align: 'center', baseline: 'middle' });

TT.board.stageFrame(ctx, { W, H });

scenes.narration: 前209年，刘邦押刑徒去骊山。行至丰西泽，人已逃了大半。
code: const T = api.t; const C = TT.chronicle; const MAP = C.readData(api.data('map'));
const CUES = api.cues.length ? api.cues : [
{ text: '前209年，刘邦押刑徒去骊山。', start: 0.7, end: 4.0 },
{ text: '行至丰西泽，人已逃了大半。', start: 4.2, end: 7.6 }
const at = (i, dt = 0) => (CUES[i]?.start ?? 0) + dt;
TT.board.stage(ctx, { W, H }, { seed: 3, variant: 0, screen: 'white' });
TT.text(ctx, '押送 · 沛县 → 丰西泽', W * 0.5, H * 0.095, 34, { fontKey: 'sans-900', color: '#5B4030', align: 'center', baseline: 'middle' });
const frame = C.map(ctx, MAP, { t: T, at: 0.2, x: 150, y: 140, w: 1620, h: 660, style: 'antique' });
C.place(ctx, { t: T, at: at(0, 0.1), frame, point: MAP.places.peixian.point, name: MAP.places.peixian.name, color: 'ochre' });
C.place(ctx, { t: T, at: at(0, 0.6), frame, point: MAP.places.fengxi.point, name: MAP.places.fengxi.name, color: 'red' });

if (route) C.seal(ctx, { t: T, at: at(0, 0.3), x: route.x, y: route.y - 48, text: '刘', sub: '刘邦', radius: 42, fontSize: 36, subSize: 28, active: true });

scenes.narration: 两条路摆在纸上：继续押送，到骊山也交不了差；就地放走，自由给了众人，罪责留给自己。
code: const T = api.t; const C = TT.chronicle;
const CUES = api.cues.length ? api.cues : [
{ text: '两条路摆在纸上：继续押送，到骊山也交不了差。', start: 0.7, end: 5.2 },
{ text: '就地放走，自由给了众人，罪责留给自己。', start: 5.5, end: 10.6 }
const at = (i, dt = 0) => (CUES[i]?.start ?? 0) + dt;
TT.board.stage(ctx, { W, H }, { seed: 3, variant: 0, screen: 'white' });
const B = C.fork(ctx, {
title: '丰西泽之夜 · 纸上推演',
selected: T >= CUES[1].start + 0.2 ? 1 : -1,
branches: [
{ label: '继续押送骊山', note: '到骊山也难交差', icon: api.img('gate'), to: [0.86, 0.24], at: at(0, 0.3), bend: -0.18 },
{ label: '就地放徒', note: '众人自由 · 刘邦担罪', icon: api.img('flame'), color: 'red', to: [0.86, 0.78], at: at(0, 0.75), bend: 0.18 }
if (B) {
const chosen = B.branches[1];
const walk = C.seg(T, CUES[1].start + 0.3, CUES[1].start + 1.8, C.E.sine);
const pos = walk > 0 ? C.pointOnPath(chosen.points, 0.12 + walk * 0.43) : B.fork;
C.seal(ctx, { t: T, at: at(0, 0.15), x: pos.x, y: pos.y - 6, text: '刘', radius: 44, fontSize: 38, active: T >= CUES[1].start });
if (T >= CUES[1].start + 0.55) C.seal(ctx, { t: T, at: CUES[1].start + 0.55, x: B.fork.x, y: B.fork.y + 4, text: '决', shape: 'square', radius: 30, fontSize: 30, color: '#7A1E14' });
C.systemCaption(ctx, CUES.find((c) => T >= c.start && T < c.end), { t: T, W, H });
TT.board.stageFrame(ctx, { W, H });

scenes.narration: 他解开绳索，众人四散。有人走远，也有人转身回来。十余壮士从此跟着他。
code: const T = api.t; const C = TT.chronicle;
const CUES = api.cues.length ? api.cues : [
{ text: '他解开绳索，众人四散。', start: 0.7, end: 3.4 },
{ text: '有人走远，也有人转身回来。', start: 3.7, end: 6.4 },
{ text: '十余壮士从此跟着他。', start: 6.7, end: 9.6 }
const at = (i, dt = 0) => (CUES[i]?.start ?? 0) + dt;
const mix = (a, b, k) => a + (b - a) * k;
TT.board.stage(ctx, { W, H }, { seed: 3, variant: 0, screen: 'white' });
TT.text(ctx, '放徒之后', 150, 150, 42, { fontKey: 'sans-900', color: '#7A1E14', align: 'left', baseline: 'middle' });
TT.text(ctx, '丰西泽 · 夜', 1770, 150, 30, { fontKey: 'sans-400', color: '#5B4030', align: 'right', baseline: 'middle' });
ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(235,206,150,.35)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(1470, 400, 105, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();
const VP = { x: 300, y: 700 };
const PEOPLE = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => ({
PEOPLE.filter((p) => !p.stay).forEach((p, k) => { p.order = k; p.slot = SLOTS[k]; });
const leaveBase = at(0, 0.3); const backBase = at(1, 0.2);
const draws = [];
for (const p of PEOPLE) {
let x, y, h, alpha = 1, dir = -1, phase = 0;
if (p.stay) {
const back = C.seg(T, backBase + (p.i === 9 ? 0.18 : 0), backBase + 1.9, C.E.sine);
x = mix(p.hx - 34, p.target.x, back); y = mix(p.hy, p.target.y, back); h = mix(p.h, p.target.h, back);
dir = back > 0.03 ? 1 : -1; phase = back > 0.02 && back < 0.98 ? back : 0;
} else {
const went = C.seg(T, leaveBase + p.delay, leaveBase + p.delay + 1.6, C.E.sine);
const rStart = at(2, 0.05) + (p.order % 4) * 0.12;
const rp = C.seg(T, rStart, rStart + 2.1, C.E.sine);
if (rp <= 0) { x = mix(p.hx, vp.x, went); y = mix(p.hy, vp.y, went); h = mix(p.h, 46, went); alpha = 1 - 0.55 * C.seg(went, 0.4, 1); dir = -1; phase = went > 0.02 && went < 0.98 ? went : 0; }
else { x = mix(vp.x, p.slot.x, rp); y = mix(vp.y, p.slot.y, rp); h = mix(46, p.slot.h, rp); alpha = Math.min(1, 0.45 + rp * 1.6); dir = 1; phase = rp > 0.02 && rp < 0.98 ? rp : 0; }
draws.push({ ...p, x, y, h, alpha, dir, phase, bob: Math.sin(phase * Math.PI * 9) * 2.4 });
draws.sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y);
for (const p of draws) C.figure(ctx, { t: T, at: -10, x: p.x, y: p.y, h: p.h, color: p.color, lean: p.lean, bob: p.bob, alpha: p.alpha, dir: p.dir });
C.figure(ctx, { t: T, at: 0.2, x: 1660, y: 852, h: 232, style: 'leader', color: 'red', dir: -1 });
TT.text(ctx, '刘邦', 1660, 590, 34, { fontKey: 'sans-900', color: '#3B2819', align: 'center', baseline: 'bottom' });
const crowdQ = 1 - C.seg(T, at(0, 0.8), at(0, 1.5), C.E.out);
if (crowdQ > 0) { ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha *= crowdQ; TT.text(ctx, '众人', 1180, 618, 32, { fontKey: 'sans-900', color: '#6B5B4A', align: 'center', baseline: 'bottom' }); ctx.restore(); }
const tenQ = C.seg(T, at(2, 0.6), at(2, 1.05), C.E.out);
if (tenQ > 0) { ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha *= tenQ; TT.text(ctx, '从者十余', 1150, 618, 32, { fontKey: 'sans-900', color: '#7A1E14', align: 'center', baseline: 'bottom' }); ctx.restore(); }
C.systemCaption(ctx, CUES.find((c) => T >= c.start && T < c.end), { t: T, W, H });
TT.board.stageFrame(ctx, { W, H });

scenes.narration: 从此，沛县起兵、先入关中、建立汉朝。那夜留下的十几个人，成了最初的班底。
code: const T = api.t; const C = TT.chronicle;
const CUES = api.cues.length ? api.cues : [
{ text: '从此，沛县起兵、先入关中、建立汉朝。', start: 0.7, end: 5.2 },
{ text: '那夜留下的十几个人，成了最初的班底。', start: 5.5, end: 9.6 }
const at = (i, dt = 0) => (CUES[i]?.start ?? 0) + dt;
TT.board.stage(ctx, { W, H }, { seed: 3, variant: 0, screen: 'white' });
TT.text(ctx, '从丰西泽到汉', W * 0.5, H * 0.16, 44, { fontKey: 'sans-900', color: '#7A1E14', align: 'center', baseline: 'middle' });
const span = CUES[0].end - CUES[0].start;
const beats = [CUES[0].start + span * 0.16, CUES[0].start + span * 0.5, CUES[0].start + span * 0.84];
C.timeline(ctx, {
events: [
{ year: '前209', label: '沛县起兵', at: beats[0], icon: api.img('banner'), above: true },
{ year: '前207', label: '先入关中', at: beats[1], icon: api.img('gate'), above: false },
